source: Super Minds 1 First Edition Teacher's Book
scope: Year 1 At School SB14-21 verified scan guidance

guidance.aims: Present the unit picture story and review classroom objects and imperatives.
guidance.warm_up: Recall the Super Friends, their powers and the cat before revisiting the story context.
guidance.student_book_procedure: Use SB pp14-15: identify characters and classroom objects, play the story, pause at key frames for comprehension, discuss helping each other, then replay for listen-and-repeat and role-play.
guidance.workbook_procedure: WB p14: listen and tick the matching story pictures, find Flash in the story, and match key phrases to numbers.
guidance.audio_procedure: SB story uses CD1 Track 21; WB p14 uses CD1 Track 22.
guidance.checking_feedback: Pairs compare before whole-class checking; pause at selected story frames to check comprehension.
guidance.ending_lesson: Groups of seven take character roles, practise the story and perform it.
guidance.extension_optional: Give short story sequences in mixed order for pairs to reconstruct.

guidance.aims: Discuss story meaning and practise the short vowel sound a.
guidance.warm_up: Recycle polite/helping phrases from the story through a quick pass-the-object routine.
guidance.student_book_procedure: On SB p15 replay and reread the story, find matching pictures and identify who says a target phrase; isolate the /a/ sound and practise the sound sentence at different speeds and volumes.
guidance.workbook_procedure: WB p15: identify the helping-each-other value, then write/match words containing the short a sound and listen/repeat.
guidance.audio_procedure: SB p15 uses CD1 Track 23; WB p15 uses CD1 Track 24.
guidance.checking_feedback: Check matching answers as a class and compare sound/spelling responses with partners.
guidance.ending_lesson: Dictate the sound sentence, compare versions in pairs, then run a spelling check with familiar short-a words.
guidance.extension_optional: Discuss why apologising and helping others matter, using pupils' own examples.

guidance.aims: Practise listening/reading for specific information and present This is my desk / There's a ... .
guidance.warm_up: Review classroom objects with a hidden drawing/guessing game using Is it a ...?.
guidance.student_book_procedure: On SB p16 listen to five children describing desks, draw lines to match speakers/desks, compare in pairs and replay to check.
guidance.workbook_procedure: WB p16: read descriptions and mark each statement with a tick or cross.
guidance.checking_feedback: Pairs compare listening matches before class checking; ask pupils to justify choices using visible desk objects.
guidance.ending_lesson: Build an oral chain beginning This is my desk. There's a ... and add one object each turn.
guidance.extension_optional: Pupils draw their own desk and write a short description using the target pattern.

guidance.aims: Practise integrated reading, speaking, writing and listening with classroom objects and imperatives.
guidance.warm_up: Replay the Please imperative game and vary the classroom objects/instructions.
guidance.student_book_procedure: On SB p17 read and choose the correct pictures, ask/answer in pairs, then draw a school bag and write a short modelled description.
guidance.workbook_procedure: WB p17: listen and number classroom objects according to the instructions.
guidance.checking_feedback: Check picture choices as a class; monitor pair questions and review written bag descriptions before final copying.
guidance.ending_lesson: Volunteers show their bag pictures and read descriptions; classmates listen for how many items are mentioned.
guidance.extension_optional: Unscramble imperative phrases and reconstruct the correct word order.

guidance.aims: Integrate Art through English and classify primary/secondary colours.
guidance.warm_up: Create a colour mind map and elicit classroom objects associated with each colour.
guidance.student_book_procedure: On SB p18 identify primary colours, discuss objects with those colours, then read about and predict how secondary colours are made before mixing/confirming.
guidance.workbook_procedure: WB p18: complete the primary/secondary colour chart, then read, write and colour using pupils' knowledge.
guidance.audio_procedure: No exact audio track is introduced on this Teacher's Book page.
guidance.checking_feedback: Groups share colour examples and discuss colour-mixing answers before class confirmation.
guidance.ending_lesson: Pupils complete the reflection prompt Today I've learnt about... in their notebooks.
guidance.extension_optional: Create a colour wheel and label the colours.

guidance.aims: Extend Art through English and complete a colour project.
guidance.warm_up: Recall previous colour vocabulary and distinguish the primary colours.
guidance.student_book_procedure: On SB p19 read and answer about colours, predict how white changes colours, then make a picture using primary/secondary colours and colour mixing.
guidance.workbook_procedure: WB p19: complete the colour-code picture.
guidance.audio_procedure: No exact audio track is introduced on this Teacher's Book page.
guidance.checking_feedback: Pairs discuss predictions, then compare results after mixing/colouring; review project language orally.
guidance.ending_lesson: Complete a Today I've... reflection focused on colour learning and the finished picture.
guidance.extension_optional: Pupils create their own colour-code pictures and swap with a partner to solve.

guidance.aims: Develop listening and acting through sequenced classroom instructions.
guidance.warm_up: Review familiar imperatives by having pupils take turns giving simple instructions.
guidance.student_book_procedure: On SB p20 listen and mime a sequence, listen again to number pictures, read and order story instructions, then practise giving/following instructions in pairs.
guidance.workbook_procedure: WB p20: follow the illustrated instructions to make a pencil holder.
guidance.checking_feedback: Pairs compare sequencing answers before class checking; monitor whether instructions are followed in order.
guidance.ending_lesson: Pairs write four instructions, exchange them and act out the partner's sequence.
guidance.extension_optional: Use the finished pencil holders for a pair instruction game about putting in and taking out classroom objects.

guidance.aims: Review unit language, consolidate classroom objects/colours and reflect on learning.
guidance.student_book_procedure: On SB p21 pairs make a poster, then use classmates' posters for a memory task about school objects and colours; review classroom-object vocabulary through the picture dictionary.
guidance.workbook_procedure: WB p21: draw and write examples of what pupils know from the unit.
guidance.audio_procedure: No exact audio track is introduced on this Teacher's Book page.
guidance.checking_feedback: Pairs/groups compare posters and memory statements; review written/drawn learning examples.
guidance.ending_lesson: Ask pupils for their favourite unit song, chant or game and repeat one with the class.
guidance.extension_optional: Groups share their WB p21 learning examples and compare what they have written and drawn.
